---
title: "Quiz · Hands"
---

A short knowledge check. Answers are hidden behind callouts so you can
self-grade after answering.

## 1. What distinguishes Mind from Hands?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
The **Mind** determines *should I do this?*; the **Hands** determine *how do
I do this?*.
:::

## 2. Why are Hands provider-neutral (capability-based)?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
So the Pico depends on capabilities like `email.send` rather than a
provider's tool names like `GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL`. The provider can then be
swapped without changing Pico behaviour or rules.
:::

## 3. What is the fundamental security rule for Hands?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
No Hand acts without identity and authorization context. A valid credential
does not imply authorization.
:::

## 4. How are Hands different from MCP?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Hands are the Pico capability abstraction; MCP is an integration mechanism
through which tools may be discovered or executed; Composio is a
provider/platform. These concerns remain separate.
:::
